messages.text: Hi! I'm teacher Max. So nice to see you! What is your name?[STUDENT_TALK]
Wow! A robot dog! What a cool friend. Are you happy today?[STUDENT_TALK]
Wow! I am glad you are happy. Are you ready for today's lesson?[STUDENT_TALK]
Wow, you are 6! 6 is a great age! Are you ready for today's lesson?[STUDENT_TALK]
